*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font:14px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif}

input{max-width:320px;padding:8px 10px;margin:0 0 12px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:7px;color:var(--fg)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:980px}th,td{text-align:left;padding:7px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);font:12.5px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;vertical-align:top}
th{font-size:10px;color:var(--fg3);text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}th.on{color:var(--cyan)}

<div class="wrap">
<h1>Materials orders and consumption</h1>
<p class="sub">Sector inventories-to-sales from the live FRED tape already on inventory-drawdown, mapped to XLI / XLB / XRT / Autos when the producer tagged an ETF. Firm rows join DIO + RPO + capex. Census M3 new orders other than NEWORDER, unfilled orders, inventories, the ISM new-orders minus inventories spread, and 10-K purchase-obligation dollars stay blank — those packets are not published. Click headers to sort.</p>
<div id="kpis"></div>
<h2>Sector I/S tape</h2>
<p class="sub" id="secStatus">Loading inventory-drawdown.json</p>
<div id="secBoard" class="table-region">Loading sector tape.</div>
<h2>Official order series</h2>
<p class="sub" id="m3Status">NEWORDER fills only from canary-macro.json. Other M3 / ISM identities stay blank.</p>
<div id="m3Board" class="table-region"></div>
<h2>Firm DIO + RPO + capex</h2>
<input id="q" placeholder="filter ticker or sector" autocomplete="off">
<p class="sub" id="firmStatus">Loading firm feeds.</p>
<div id="firmBoard" class="table-region">Loading firm rows.</div>
<div class="foot"><b>Built for:</b> watching materials ordering vs consumption at the sector ETF and the firm, without inventing Census/ISM prints or purchase-commitment dollars.<br>
<b>Data:</b> /data/inventory-drawdown.json sector_drawdown[] and stock_drawdown_board[]; /data/backlog.json by_ticker object (RPO when tagged); /data/capex-pulse.json rows[]; /data/canary-macro.json NEWORDER (value + prev only).<br>
<b>Map:</b> Manufacturing MNFCTRIRSA to XLI; building materials theme_etf XLB when tagged; Retail/general merchandise to XRT; Autos AISRSA shown as Autos when theme_etf is null — no ETF invented.<br>
<b>Blank on purpose:</b> AMTMNO / AMTMUO / UMTMTI / DGORDER and ISM new-orders/inventories are not published as /data JSON. 10-K purchase-obligation tags were not found on any live firm row.<br>
<b>Not:</b> an 8-K body parser, a per-ETF materials PO book, or a replacement of the inventory boom board. Research only.</div>
</div>
<script>
function esc(s){s=String(s==null?"":s);return s.replace(/&/g,"&"+"amp;").replace(/</g,"&"+"lt;").replace(/>/g,"&"+"gt;").replace(/"/g,"&"+"quot;").replace(/'/g,"&#39;");}
function num(v){if(v==null||v==="")return null;var n=Number(v);return isFinite(n)?n:null;}
function pct(v){var n=num(v);return n==null?"":n.toFixed(1)+"%";}
function cls(v){var n=num(v);return n==null?"":(n>0?"pos":(n<0?"neg":""));}
function fmt(v,d){var n=num(v);return n==null?"":n.toFixed(d==null?2:d);}
function bn(v){var n=num(v);if(n==null)return "";if(Math.abs(n)>=1e9)return (n/1e9).toFixed(2)+"B";if(Math.abs(n)>=1e6)return (n/1e6).toFixed(2)+"M";return String(n);}
function cmp(a,b,k,dir){
  var av=a[k],bv=b[k];
  if(av==null||av===""){if(bv==null||bv==="")return String(a.ticker||a.sector||a.id||"").localeCompare(String(b.ticker||b.sector||b.id||""));return 1;}
  if(bv==null||bv==="")return -1;
  if(typeof av==="number"&&typeof bv==="number")return (av-bv)*dir;
  return String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))*dir;
}
function table(id,cols,rows,sort,dir,onSort){
  var h="<table><thead><tr>";
  cols.forEach(function(c){h+="<th class='"+(c.r?"r ":"")+(sort===c.k?"on":"")+"' data-k='"+c.k+"'>"+c.l+(sort===c.k?(dir>0?" \u2191":" \u2193"):"")+"</th>";});
  h+="</tr></thead><tbody>";
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    h+="<tr>";
    cols.forEach(function(c){
      var raw=c.cell?c.cell(r):esc(r[c.k]==null?"":r[c.k]);
      h+="<td class='"+(c.r?"r ":"")+(c.cls?c.cls(r):"")+"'>"+raw+"</td>";
    });
    h+="</tr>";
  });
  document.getElementById(id).innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table>";
  document.querySelectorAll("#"+id+" th[data-k]").forEach(function(th){
    th.onclick=function(){onSort(th.getAttribute("data-k"));};
  });
}
async function load(path){
  try{var r=await fetch(path+"?t="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"});if(!r.ok)return null;return await r.json();}catch(e){return null;}
}
function bookList(book){
  var bt=book&&book.by_ticker;
  if(!bt)return [];
  if(Array.isArray(bt))return bt;
  return Object.keys(bt).map(function(k){return bt[k];});
}
(async function(){
  var inv=await load("/data/inventory-drawdown.json");
  var book=await load("/data/backlog.json");
  var cap=await load("/data/capex-pulse.json");
  var macro=await load("/data/canary-macro.json");
  var sectors=(inv&&Array.isArray(inv.sector_drawdown))?inv.sector_drawdown:[];
  var focus=sectors.filter(function(s){
    var etf=String(s.theme_etf||"").toUpperCase();
    var name=String(s.sector||"");
    return etf==="XLI"||etf==="XLB"||etf==="XRT"||/^auto/i.test(name)||s.series==="AISRSA"||s.series==="MNFCTRIRSA"||s.series==="RETAILIRSA"||s.series==="MRTSIR444USS"||s.series==="MRTSIR452USS"||s.series==="MRTSIR441USS";
  });
  var secSort="drawdown_score",secDir=-1;
  function paintSec(){
    var rows=focus.slice().sort(function(a,b){return cmp(a,b,secSort,secDir);});
    table("secBoard",[
      {k:"theme_etf",l:"Map"},
      {k:"sector",l:"Sector"},
      {k:"series",l:"FRED series"},
      {k:"latest_ratio",l:"I/S",r:1,cell:function(r){return esc(fmt(r.latest_ratio,3));}},
      {k:"chg_3m",l:"3m",r:1,cls:function(r){return cls(r.chg_3m);},cell:function(r){return esc(pct(r.chg_3m));}},
      {k:"chg_6m",l:"6m",r:1,cls:function(r){return cls(r.chg_6m);},cell:function(r){return esc(pct(r.chg_6m));}},
      {k:"chg_12m",l:"12m",r:1,cls:function(r){return cls(r.chg_12m);},cell:function(r){return esc(pct(r.chg_12m));}},
      {k:"flag",l:"Flag"}
    ],rows,secSort,secDir,function(k){if(secSort===k)secDir=-secDir;else{secSort=k;secDir=k==="sector"||k==="theme_etf"||k==="series"||k==="flag"?1:-1;}paintSec();});
    document.getElementById("secStatus").textContent=rows.length+" mapped sector rows from inventory-drawdown.json. Generated "+((inv&&inv.generated_at)||"")+". Negative I/S change = drawing down.";
  }
  if(!sectors.length)document.getElementById("secBoard").textContent="inventory-drawdown.json missing or sector_drawdown[] empty.";
  else paintSec();

  var nObj=macro&&macro.NEWORDER;
  var nVal=nObj?num(nObj.value):null;
  var nPrev=nObj?num(nObj.prev):null;
  var nMom=(nVal!=null&&nPrev!=null&&nPrev!==0)?((nVal-nPrev)/Math.abs(nPrev))*100:null;
  var reserved=[
    {id:"AMTMNO",label:"Census M3 new orders — total manufacturing",map:"XLI",level:null,mom:null,asof:""},
    {id:"AMTMUO",label:"Census M3 unfilled orders — total manufacturing",map:"XLI",level:null,mom:null,asof:""},
    {id:"UMTMTI",label:"Census M3 total inventories — manufacturing",map:"XLI",level:null,mom:null,asof:""},
    {id:"DGORDER",label:"Census M3 new orders — durable goods",map:"XLI",level:null,mom:null,asof:""},
    {id:"NEWORDER",label:"Census M3 new orders — core capital goods ex-aircraft",map:"XLI",level:nVal,mom:nMom,asof:nObj?(nObj.as_of||""):""},
    {id:"ISM_NO_INV",label:"ISM new orders minus inventories spread",map:"XLI / XLB",level:null,mom:null,asof:""}
  ];
  var m3Sort="id",m3Dir=1;
  function paintM3(){
    var rows=reserved.slice().sort(function(a,b){return cmp(a,b,m3Sort,m3Dir);});
    table("m3Board",[
      {k:"id",l:"Identity"},
      {k:"label",l:"What it measures"},
      {k:"map",l:"ETF map"},
      {k:"level",l:"Level $M",r:1,cell:function(r){return esc(fmt(r.level,0));}},
      {k:"mom",l:"MoM",r:1,cls:function(r){return cls(r.mom);},cell:function(r){return esc(pct(r.mom));}},
      {k:"asof",l:"As of"}
    ],rows,m3Sort,m3Dir,function(k){if(m3Sort===k)m3Dir=-m3Dir;else{m3Sort=k;m3Dir=k==="id"||k==="label"||k==="map"||k==="asof"?1:-1;}paintM3();});
    document.getElementById("m3Status").textContent=nVal==null?"NEWORDER missing from canary-macro.json. Other M3/ISM identities stay blank.":"NEWORDER "+nVal.toFixed(0)+" million as of "+(nObj.as_of||"")+". MoM uses prev only. Other M3/ISM identities stay blank.";
  }
  paintM3();

  var dioRows=(inv&&Array.isArray(inv.stock_drawdown_board))?inv.stock_drawdown_board:[];
  var bookRows=bookList(book);
  var capRows=(cap&&Array.isArray(cap.rows))?cap.rows:[];
  var by={};
  function row(t){t=String(t||"").toUpperCase();if(!t)return null;if(!by[t])by[t]={ticker:t,sector:"",dio:null,dio_chg:null,rev_yoy:null,rpo:null,rpo_yoy:null,capex:null,capex_yoy:null,po:null};return by[t];}
  dioRows.forEach(function(r){var x=row(r.ticker);if(!x)return;x.sector=r.sector||x.sector;x.dio=num(r.dio_latest);x.dio_chg=num(r.dio_chg_pct);x.rev_yoy=num(r.rev_growth_yoy);});
  bookRows.forEach(function(r){var x=row(r.ticker);if(!x)return;if(r.sector)x.sector=x.sector||r.sector;x.rpo=num(r.rpo);x.rpo_yoy=num(r.rpo_yoy);});
  capRows.forEach(function(r){var x=row(r.ticker);if(!x)return;if(r.sector)x.sector=x.sector||r.sector;x.capex=num(r.capex_ttm_b);x.capex_yoy=num(r.yoy_pct);});
  var firms=Object.keys(by).map(function(k){return by[k];}).filter(function(r){return r.dio!=null||r.rpo!=null||r.capex!=null;});
  var firmSort="dio_chg",firmDir=1,qEl=document.getElementById("q");
  function paintFirm(){
    var q=(qEl.value||"").toUpperCase();
    var list=firms.filter(function(r){return !q||(r.ticker+" "+(r.sector||"")).toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;}).slice().sort(function(a,b){return cmp(a,b,firmSort,firmDir);});
    table("firmBoard",[
      {k:"ticker",l:"Ticker",cell:function(r){return "<a href=\"/ticker.html?symbol="+encodeURIComponent(r.ticker)+"\">"+esc(r.ticker)+"</a>";}},
      {k:"sector",l:"Sector"},
      {k:"dio",l:"DIO",r:1,cell:function(r){return esc(fmt(r.dio,1));}},
      {k:"dio_chg",l:"DIO YoY",r:1,cls:function(r){return cls(r.dio_chg);},cell:function(r){return esc(pct(r.dio_chg));}},
      {k:"rev_yoy",l:"Rev YoY",r:1,cls:function(r){return cls(r.rev_yoy);},cell:function(r){return esc(pct(r.rev_yoy));}},
      {k:"rpo",l:"RPO",r:1,cell:function(r){return esc(bn(r.rpo));}},
      {k:"rpo_yoy",l:"RPO YoY",r:1,cls:function(r){return cls(r.rpo_yoy);},cell:function(r){return esc(pct(r.rpo_yoy));}},
      {k:"capex",l:"Capex TTM $B",r:1,cell:function(r){return esc(fmt(r.capex,2));}},
      {k:"capex_yoy",l:"Capex YoY",r:1,cls:function(r){return cls(r.capex_yoy);},cell:function(r){return esc(pct(r.capex_yoy));}},
      {k:"po",l:"Purchase obligation $",r:1,cell:function(){return "";}}
    ],list,firmSort,firmDir,function(k){if(firmSort===k)firmDir=-firmDir;else{firmSort=k;firmDir=(k==="ticker"||k==="sector")?1:-1;}paintFirm();});
    document.getElementById("firmStatus").textContent=list.length+" firms with DIO, RPO or capex. Purchase-obligation $ blank — tag not on these rows. Click headers to sort.";
  }
  var nDio=dioRows.length,nBook=bookRows.filter(function(r){return num(r.rpo)!=null;}).length,nCap=capRows.length;
  document.getElementById("kpis").innerHTML="<span class=\"chip\">"+nDio+" DIO names</span><span class=\"chip\">"+nBook+" tagged RPO</span><span class=\"chip\">"+nCap+" capex rows</span><span class=\"chip\">NEWORDER "+(nVal==null?"blank":nVal.toFixed(0)+"M")+"</span><span class=\"chip\">PO tag absent</span>";
  if(!firms.length)document.getElementById("firmBoard").textContent="No firm DIO/RPO/capex rows received.";
  else {qEl.oninput=paintFirm;paintFirm();}
})();
</script>
